feedback.answered: The read queue intentionally returns an ordered prefix with each original context intact. The leader local branch uses each status context, while the remote branch uses the triggering heartbeat context for every returned status. The receiving follower and request tracker consume the reply context without restoring the original identity. Existing timeout handling is not a repair of that identity handoff.
